Europe Battles Widespread Wildfires Amidst Heatwave

Wildfires are raging across France, Spain, and Greece, exacerbated by a severe heatwave and high winds. In France, nearly 4,000 people were evacuated from tourist sites near Bordeaux, and the country's wine industry faces a wake-up call. French President Emmanuel Macron described the fight against the blazes as the 'toughest crisis since the Second World War'. In Greece, three firefighters were killed battling a wildfire on Crete. Spain's Prime Minister highlighted the fires as a reminder to plan for a worsening climate emergency.
